title: Link
description: Represents a labeled link to a social media profile, professional network, website, or other online resource.

label.title: Link Label
label.description: The display name or label identifying the linked resource.

url.title: Link URL
url.description: The URI of the linked social profile, professional network, website, or online resource.

icon.title: Link Icon
icon.description: The name, identifier, or path of an icon representing the link.
